test_title: PYST 9: SSC CHSL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In May 2023, the Supreme Court of India issued a set of directions to strengthen the POSH Act. To which of the following is this Act related?

options.text: Sexual harassment of women at workplace

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sexual harassment of women at workplace**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The POSH Act stands for the **Prevention of Sexual Harassment** at Workplace Act.
 
• It was enacted in **2013** to ensure a safe and secure working environment for women.
 
• The Act mandates the formation of an **Internal Complaints Committee (ICC)** at all workplaces with ten or more employees to address complaints of sexual harassment.
 
• The Act also outlines the **redressal mechanism** and the **penalties** for non-compliance by employers.
 
• In May 2023, the Supreme Court of India issued directions to **strengthen the implementation** of the POSH Act, emphasizing the need for active and effective ICCs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The POSH Act was formulated based on the guidelines laid down by the Supreme Court in the **Vishaka case** in 1997.
 
• The Act covers not only traditional workplaces but also **extended workplaces** such as transportation provided by the employer, places visited by employees during the course of employment, etc.
 
• Employers are required to conduct **regular sensitization programs** and workshops to educate employees about the provisions of the Act and the importance of a harassment-free workplace.
 
• The Act also provides protection against **victimization** of the complainant and witnesses.
 
• Non-compliance with the POSH Act can lead to penalties, including fines and cancellation of business licenses.
